content:
Jayson Tatum beat the overtime buzzer on Tuesday night, hitting an elbow jumper as time expired to give the Boston Celtics a 125-124 win over the visiting Brooklyn Nets at TD Garden.

Tatum scored a game-high 40 points and hit a career-high 18 free throws on 22 attempts, while Paul George added 20 points, seven rebounds and seven assists for Boston, which won its third game in a row and improved to 3-1. Michael Porter Jr. led Brooklyn with 27 points and 12 rebounds, and Julius Randle added 24 points and nine rebounds as the Nets fell to 0-4. Brooklyn trailed 117-114 late in the fourth quarter before Mikel Brown Jr. forced overtime with a three-pointer with one second left.

In San Antonio, Victor Wembanyama poured in 29 points and grabbed 10 rebounds in just 27 minutes as the Spurs steamrolled the Sacramento Kings 130-103 at the Frost Bank Center. Julian Champagnie added 26 points, including eight first-half three-pointers, as San Antonio set league season highs for points, assists and three-pointers in a half before the break. De'Andre Hunter scored 24 for Sacramento, which dropped to 0-4.

The New York Knicks picked up their first win of the season, beating the Detroit Pistons 111-97 at Madison Square Garden. Karl-Anthony Towns scored a game-high 27 points, 13 of them during a decisive third-quarter run, and pulled down a season-high 20 rebounds, while Jalen Brunson added 23 points and seven assists. Paul Reed led Detroit with 22 points and nine rebounds.

Portland stayed unbeaten with a 136-129 win over the Los Angeles Lakers at Crypto.com Arena. The Trail Blazers improved to 3-0 while the Lakers fell to 3-1, with Portland outscoring Los Angeles 34-26 in the fourth quarter to close out the road win.

Sources: Reuters / Field Level Media; NBA.com.

excerpt: Jayson Tatum's overtime buzzer-beater lifted Boston past Brooklyn 125-124, while San Antonio routed Sacramento 130-103, New York beat Detroit 111-97, and Portland stayed unbeaten with a 136-129 win over the Lakers.
title: Tatum's OT Buzzer-Beater Lifts Celtics 125-124 Over Nets as Spurs, Knicks and Blazers Win
